reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch read 'I AM THAT I AM' as God's own explanation of the name Jehovah rather than a rival, competing divine name.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Exodus 34:14 names God's name as Jealous, while Isaiah 42:8 has God declare Yahweh alone is his name.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Editorial statement of the mechanism; catalogued by Steve Wells, Skeptic's Annotated Bible ("What is God's name?", skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/name.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
sides.verseText: for you shall worship no other god: for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

sides.snippet: I am Yahweh, that is my name
sides.verseText: I am Yahweh, that is my name; and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to engraved images.
